subject: QuantumBridge private deployment: connectivity runbook & peering ops
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@quantumbridge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Network Team <network-eng@quantumbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QuantumBridge -> Redwood: private deployment connectivity kickoff

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. We want to lock down networking responsibilities and a practical sprint for VPC peering + private endpoint configuration before we cut the on-prem package deployment next month. High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm whether Redwood's private control plane requires inbound peering (BGP) or managed VPC peering (static routes) for the private endpoint
- Expected Egress NAT & IP ranges to be published for our security team
- Validate the TLS requirements between our load balancer and Redwood edge appliance

Can you share a short runbook and a kickoff agenda? We prefer a two-week micro-sprint with a dry-run on staging. Attaching our internal networking inventory (stub).

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Nguyen
Head of Infrastructure
QuantumBridge

Attachments: QB-network-inventory.csv (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@quantumbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Jun 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantumBridge -> Redwood: private deployment connectivity kickoff

Alice —

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a short connectivity runbook and a first draft VPC design (QB-vpc-design-v1.pdf). Key notes up front:
- Redwood supports managed VPC peering (preferred) and a BGP-backed interconnect for high-throughput private deployments. For your initial rollout we recommend managed peering + static routes.
- Egress IP ranges: 35.192.0.0/14, 34.120.0.0/14 (these will be present in the runbook PDF).
- TLS: mutual TLS from your LB to the Redwood edge is optional; TLS1.3 required server-side. If you need mTLS we can enable cert provisioning through your KMS.

Proposed short sprint:
1) Prep & inventory validation (this week)
2) Staging peering + endpoint provisioning (3 days)
3) Dry-run traffic & QOS validation (2 days)
4) Cutover rehearsal + rollback verification (1 day)

Can Marissa lead the staging cut and Monica run the security checklist with your team? Aditya will own the peering automation and Terraform snippets.

-Ben

Attachments: QB-vpc-design-v1.pdf (stub), peering-checklist.xlsx (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@quantumbridge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantumBridge -> Redwood: private deployment connectivity kickoff

Hi Alice —

I'll run the staging cutover and coordinate the dry-run. Quick clarifications from our ops checklist: 
- Do you require inbound service discovery across the peering, or will private endpoint DNS be resolved via Route53 from the customer side? If the former we'll need to open additional route propagation windows.
- For the dry-run do you prefer simulated traffic from your pre-prod cluster or a synthetic load from Redwood's staging harness?

Tentative schedule: staging peering Tuesday 6/12, dry-run Wednesday 6/13, cutover rehearsal Friday 6/15. If that works, Monica and I will send calendar invites and a one-page runbook excerpt.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@quantumbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Network Team <network-eng@quantumbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QuantumBridge -> Redwood: private deployment connectivity kickoff

Marissa —

Thanks. A couple of answers from our network leads:
- We'll keep service discovery local; QuantumBridge will resolve private endpoint DNS in our VPC and won't rely on cross-VPC DNS propagation. We'll provide the Route53 zone delegation details by EOB Tuesday.
- For the dry-run we'll run both: our pre-prod cluster will generate realistic payloads and we ask Redwood to run the staging harness for traffic shaping comparisons.

Also attaching a short NAT/egress snippet that our firewall team asked to validate against your documented ranges.

Best,
Alice
